records.Concise description: Rune #9, a block-840,000 community asset from the Buoyant Capital-linked LOBO ecosystem, distributed largely through a free holder airdrop.
records.Deeper researched summary: LOBO•THE•WOLF•PUP was etched in block 840,000 as Rune #9 / ID `840000:35`. Its official site describes a launch tied to the team’s pre-Rune Rune Doors activity and support for the Runestone distribution effort, followed by a large free airdrop to Rune Door and Runestone holders. Current project materials show the broader LOBO ecosystem remains operated, so lifecycle is ACTIVE even though the canonical Rune supply was created at launch.
Creators / founders: Buoyant Capital-linked LOBO founding team — official site describes four founders; individual names not locked in this registry
records.Launch / history: The team participated in the pre-Runes/Runestone period, secured Rune #9 in block 840,000, and distributed LOBO to more than 72,000 eligible wallets in late April 2024 according to its official history.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: LOBO connects activation-block provenance with a documented pre-Runes community campaign and broad holder-distribution model.
records.Verification basis: Current official project history/ecosystem pages plus on-chain/indexed Rune state support identity, launch model, provenance, and current operation.
Research notes / uncertainties: The official site describes a four-founder team but this registry does not lock individual names without stronger source capture.
Avoid turning project tokenomics allocations into timeless circulating-supply claims.

records.Concise description: The canonical Rune distributed through the Runestone community, etched as Rune #3 in the Runes activation block and launched without a sale.
records.Deeper researched summary: DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON is the Rune successor to the Runestone distribution experiment. It was etched in block 840,000 as Rune #3 / ID `840000:3` with a 100-billion-unit full premine used for community distribution rather than an open mint. The project’s identity and current community operation are distinct from the historical Runestone Ordinals artifact, which remains canonically in the ORDINALS registry.
Creators / founders: Leonidas — initiator of Runestone and DOG community distribution
records.Launch / history: Runestone was distributed to a broad set of early Ordinals wallets before the Runes launch. DOG was then etched at activation as Rune #3 and distributed to the Runestone holder base without a conventional presale.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: DOG is one of the clearest bridges from the Ordinals ecosystem into Runes and a central example of using an Ordinals distribution artifact to bootstrap a Rune community.
Important technical or cultural characte: No separate Runestone duplicate in RUNES
records.Verification basis: Official DOG/Leonidas sources support the distribution relationship and current project identity; ordinals.com supports the canonical Rune state.
Research notes / uncertainties: Runestone remains the canonical ORDINALS profile and must not be duplicated as a RUNES entity.
DOG is the canonical RUNES entity; the relationship should be bidirectional in a future Master Explore Registry.
Do not describe market listings or trading as the reason for ACTIVE status.

records.Concise description: Rune #8, created as the Rune reward/distribution outcome of the pre-Runes RSIC Metaprotocol experiment.
records.Deeper researched summary: RSIC•GENESIS•RUNE is the canonical Rune connected to the RSIC Metaprotocol’s pre-launch Ordinals phase. Runes-aware sources identify it as Rune #8 / ID `840000:28` with a 21-billion-unit full premine. Community documentation describes the Rune as the payout/reward destination for RSIC’s first season. The historical RSIC Metaprotocol remains canonically in ORDINALS; this profile covers only the Rune asset.
Creators / founders: RSIC project / Metaprotocol operators — individual attribution not locked in this registry
records.Launch / history: RSIC used an Ordinals-based pre-Runes distribution/reward phase before activation. The Rune was etched in block 840,000 as Rune #8 and distributed in connection with that first-season system.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It is a major pre-Runes-to-Runes transition case and demonstrates how Ordinals assets were used to coordinate future Rune allocation before the protocol activated.
Important technical or cultural characte: Linked to the RSIC Metaprotocol Season One reward phase
Separate canonical home from the historical Ordinals metaprotocol
records.Verification basis: Indexer/on-chain-derived Rune state and community documentation support the Rune/RSIC relationship and completed Season One context. Strong current first-party operation was not verified.
Research notes / uncertainties: The 8-21 documentation is community-made and explicitly not affiliated with RSIC; treat it as corroboration, not a project-controlled source.
RSIC Metaprotocol remains an ORDINALS profile; only the Rune belongs canonically here.
Later-season or current-operation claims should not be published without fresh first-party evidence.

records.Concise description: The official Rune distributed to Based Angels holders, connecting the active 5,555-piece Ordinals project to a distinct Runes asset.
records.Deeper researched summary: BASED•ANGELS•RUNE is an official related asset of the Based Angels Ordinals project. Based Angels’ current site documents a May 2024 holder snapshot and airdrop of 75 Runes per eligible unlisted Angel. Runes-aware index data identifies the Rune as ID `840190:1620` with a 420,000-unit premine/supply and divisibility 2. Because the parent project remains active and continues to present this Rune as an official related project, the Rune is ACTIVE.
Creators / founders: Based Angels team led by 13; Spiralgaze — artist of the parent Based Angels collection
records.Launch / history: Etched shortly after Runes activation and distributed to Based Angels holders in May 2024 through an official project airdrop.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It is a clean cross-category example in which an established Ordinals collection has a materially distinct Rune that merits its own RUNES profile while the PFP collection remains in ORDINALS.
Important technical or cultural characte: Officially linked to the 5,555-piece Based Angels collection
records.Verification basis: Current Based Angels first-party site verifies the Rune relationship and distribution; indexer data supports the canonical Rune ID and numeric fields.
Research notes / uncertainties: Based Angels itself remains the canonical ORDINALS entity; do not duplicate the collection in RUNES.
Numeric Rune state sourced from an indexer should be rechecked if used in public copy.

records.Concise description: The current PUPS community Rune, evolved from an earlier BRC-20 token and culturally tied to the O.P.I.U.M./Bitcoin Puppets ecosystem.
records.Deeper researched summary: PUPS•WORLD•PEACE represents the Runes-era form of the PUPS community token. The official PUPS site documents origins in the O.P.I.U.M holder community, a 2023 BRC-20 phase, and migration to Runes. Runes-aware index data identifies the canonical Rune as #13 / ID `840000:41` with a one-billion-unit full premine and divisibility 18. MSC treats the BRC-20 predecessor as history/relationship rather than a duplicate RUNES profile.
Creators / founders: PUPS community / project operators — community-driven project; individual founder attribution not locked
records.Launch / history: PUPS began as a BRC-20 token in 2023 and migrated to Runes around the April 2024 protocol launch. Current project materials continue to support the Rune-era ecosystem.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: PUPS is a major example of a Bitcoin token community deliberately moving from BRC-20 inscription state to Runes while retaining cultural continuity with an Ordinals community.
records.Verification basis: Current official PUPS material verifies lineage/migration and ongoing project operation; Runes-aware index data supports the canonical Rune identity.
Research notes / uncertainties: Treat the BRC-20 PUPS asset as historical lineage, not a second RUNES canonical entity.
Migration ratios/windows can change or become archival; do not publish them without re-verification.
Do not infer Bitcoin-consensus equivalence between BRC-20 and Runes state.

records.Concise description: The official Bitcoin Wizard community Rune, carrying the 2013 Magic Internet Money meme lineage through a BRC-20 phase into Runes.
records.Deeper researched summary: MAGIC•INTERNET•MONEY is the official Runes-era token of the Bitcoin Wizard community. The current Bitcoin Wizard site traces the visual/meme lineage to Mavensbot’s 2013 Magic Internet Money wizard and identifies the Rune as a 21-billion-unit community asset. A dedicated migration site documents the earlier WZRD BRC-20 phase and its migration into the Runes asset. On-chain/indexed state identifies the Rune as #17 / ID `840000:45` with a 21-billion-unit full premine.
Creators / founders: Mavensbot — creator of the original 2013 Magic Internet Money wizard artwork
Bitcoin Wizard community/operators — Rune-era project stewardship
records.Launch / history: The meme originated in 2013, later became associated with Ordinals-era Bitcoin Wizards and a WZRD BRC-20 token, then migrated to the MAGIC•INTERNET•MONEY Rune in 2024–2025.
records.Why it matters in the Runes ecosystem: It connects one of Bitcoin’s oldest internet memes to both Ordinals and Runes, while also documenting an important BRC-20-to-Runes migration path.
Important technical or cultural characte: Direct cultural lineage to the 2013 Magic Internet Money wizard

Corroborating sources.label: AscendEX — WZRD to MIM migration notice

records.Verification basis: Current first-party Bitcoin Wizard and migration sites establish identity, cultural lineage, migration, and current project presence; ordinals.com supports Rune state.
Research notes / uncertainties: Mavensbot created the original meme artwork; do not automatically describe Mavensbot as the Rune etcher or current project founder.
The WZRD/BRC-20 phase is historical lineage, not a duplicate RUNES profile.
Migration mechanics should be reverified before public operational guidance.
